subject.statement: Tim Cook is currently Apple's CEO.

summary: Tim Cook has served as Apple's CEO since August 2011 and there have been no credible reports of his removal or replacement up to mid‑2024. Absent any known leadership change, it is reasonable to conclude he remained CEO through October 2026.
